class.name: FmodPerformanceData
class.brief_description: A snapshot of FMOD's CPU, memory and file usage.
class.description: Returned by [method FmodServer.get_performance_data], which updates it each time it is called. The same figures are shown as performance monitors in the editor's debugger.

members.member: The CPU usage of the first convolution reverb thread, in percent.
The CPU usage of the second convolution reverb thread, in percent.
The memory FMOD has allocated, in bytes.
The CPU usage of FMOD's mixer, in percent.
The CPU usage of FMOD's geometry occlusion, in percent.
The most memory FMOD has allocated at once, in bytes.
The bytes FMOD has read from files other than samples and streams, such as banks' metadata.
The bytes FMOD has read from files to load sample data.
The CPU usage of FMOD's streaming, in percent.
The bytes FMOD has read from files to play streams.
The CPU usage of FMOD Studio's update, in percent.
The CPU usage of FMOD Core's update, in percent.
